scope: Presentation slide and notes dimensions, orientation, first slide number and supported show settings; F10 and notes-page subset of F49
scope_method: Select every width/height unit variant and expanded presentation-dimensions BDD scenario. Include adjacent notes creation, owner/publication and all length constructor/conversion variants separately; retain every Presentation and unit-value public/inherited member as an explicit API row. Other slide graph cases stay in existing task receipts. No notes-size, orientation, first-number or slideshow-edit public member or direct case exists in the pinned source inventory; those are additive format requirements.

mapping_decisions.J01: Retain slide_width and slide_height for model property assignment. Operation fields width/height and notesWidth/notesHeight are camelCase schema arguments, not model aliases.
mapping_decisions.J02: Missing sldSz reads null. Operation inspection must not create missing notes masters, presentation dimensions or property parts. The live model and its owner identity remain pending.
mapping_decisions.J03: Settings are a singleton; no ordinal or opaque selector is accepted. Unrelated sequence/keyed-collection semantics are not changed.
mapping_decisions.J05: Operation lengths become safe integer EMUs once using nearest rounding, halfway away from zero, at 914400/in, 360000/cm, 36000/mm and 12700/pt. Numeric value objects/accessors remain unimplemented unless separately evidenced. Missing is null, explicit false is retained, undefined is omission; no implicit coercion.
mapping_decisions.J06: All input admission and mutation serialization are asynchronous through explicit byte/VFS capabilities. No ambient host I/O or native runtime. Byte results never imply a live model save method.
mapping_decisions.J07: No ambient timestamps, identity, font discovery or default vendor templates. New XML is original and only requested structures may be created.
mapping_decisions.J08: Typed operation schema errors map to CLI status 2, unsupported/document/value failures to 1, capability I/O to 3, limits to 4 and cancellation to 130. Neutral model error classes remain separately tracked.
mapping_decisions.J09: Independent ZIP/XML assertions verify only owned requested attributes changed. Public element/part model views remain security-mapped obligations, not excluded by inherited/private-looking names.
mapping_decisions.J10: settings.list/get/set use shared envelopes and schemas. Resize defaults to canvas-only. Explicit scaleContent must transform supported groups coherently or reject unsupported transforms before publication.

documentation_drift.resolution: Use inclusive -2147483648..2147483647; parent integration owns format-spec correction.

documentation_drift.finding: Format settings register omitted notes dimensions, notes orientation and explicit scale-content.
documentation_drift.resolution: Add operation fields notesWidth, notesHeight, notesOrientation and scaleContent in the same shared schema; notes-size support does not promise notes-master model API.

documentation_drift.resolution: Keep live slide_width/slide_height and every other selected model row pending; no complete SDK or published API claim.
